description.narrative: The PDO is to provide economic opportunities for Ethiopians and Refugees in an environmentally and socially sustainable way.

The development objective of Economic Opportunities Program Program-for-Results Project is to provide economic opportunities for Ethiopians and refugees in an environmentally and socially sustainable way. Ethiopia is a landlocked country that has experienced impressive growth and gains in development in the past two decades. Despite accelerated progress, Ethiopia remains challenged by the need to create economic opportunities for its fast-growing population of over 100 million, including for an estimated 20 million Ethiopians living below the poverty line. A hybrid Program for Results (PforR) and Investment Project Financing (IPF) operation is chosen to address the mix of policy actions, investment activity, and technical assistance to achieve the desired outcomes of the Economic opportunities program. The Economic opportunities program will support a subset of the government's jobs compact program. The activities supported by the PforR constitute the boundary of the program and have been selected based on the World Bank Group's strengths and ongoing development operations.

title.narrative: Directives amended to permit establishment of foreign exchange accounts and to permit higher debt-equity ratio for foreign investors

comment.narrative: The GoE has made a series of amendments on forex retention policy. The latest amendment was announced on 29 July 2024 (in Directive No. FXD/01/2024). The directive includes changes for Banks to buy and sell foreign currencies at freely negotiated rates, remove surrender requirement to NBE, and allows exporters to retain 50 percent of their foreign exchange proceeds vs 40 percent previously.

The FEAAC is conducting verification at the 4 implementing institutions and industrial parks on fraud and corruption allegations, investigations and actions taken and reporting to the Bank on bi-annual basis.
The verification shows the complaint handling mechanism including recording and reporting of complaints at the industrial parks need to be improved.

title.narrative: Number of Ethiopians with access to economic opportunities

comment.narrative:
The indicator refers to the net jobs, determined by deducting the number of resigned employees from the total new workers employed in the 4 IPs (Bole lemi, Hawassa, Kombolcha and Mekele).
The net job creation is not increasing as planned due to non-operation of Mekelle IP in Tigray, security issues and suspension of AGOA.
